interpretation.core: Combined state, feature/rule, grouping and allocation work; component costs are not separately identified.
interpretation.memory: One separate fresh process per nested prefix; RSS sampled before checkpoint serialization. Whole-process memory is not exact Python state size; seen and order-key ledgers retain every accepted record.
interpretation.nonservice_loop: All measured loop wall outside those stages, including trace output, hashing, validation, bookkeeping and file open/close; not pure instrumentation overhead.
interpretation.quantiles: Nearest rank ceil(p*N)-1 separately per worker; median/min/max across five runs, no pooled confidence interval.
interpretation.queue: Lossless finite-trace virtual FCFS; original event-time budgets unchanged. Half-open waiting [arrival,start) and system [arrival,finish), zero intervals excluded.
interpretation.service: Six contiguous local stages: buffered read, JSON parse, syntactic decode, aggregate unchanged core, decision JSON encode, buffered gzip write.
interpretation.uniform_acquisition_delays: Adding any common nonnegative acquisition delay to all modeled arrivals shifts starts/finishes equally; waiting, response, makespan and queue occupancy are invariant. No extra measured experiments.
unsupported: historical arrival or live end-to-end latency
causal policy speed superiority on a shared host
